item.title: Bennett eulogizes Netanel Shokron: 'We lost a humble man who was devoted to his family'
item.description:
Together Party chairman Naftali Bennett eulogized Netanel Shokron, 50, a father of six and resident of Alei Zahav, who was murdered by a terrorist on Sunday morning after going with his eldest son to immerse in a spring ahead of Yom Kippur.
“Those who knew Netanel say he was a man of kindness and generosity. This was evident in the hundreds of days of reserve duty he devoted to the country in recent years and in the volunteer and community work he pursued alongside his job as an information systems analyst.
“Today, we lost a humble man who was devoted to his family, loved people and loved the Land of Israel," Bennett added. “I extend my condolences to his family over this unimaginable loss. May his memory be a blessing."

item.title: Huckabee challenges media after shooting attack: 'We will be watching...& waiting'
item.description:
Following the shooting attack that claimed the life of Netanel Shakron, a father of six from Alei Zahav, US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee challenged the international media to cover the attack as it does violence by Jewish extremists in Judea and Samaria.
"This Israeli father of 6 murdered in front of one of his children. The Palestinian terrorist was captured. Let's hope there will be balanced reporting of these attacks by int'l media. We will be watching...& waiting."

item.title: Chief of Staff after terror attack: IDF on high alert
item.description:
The IDF Chief of the General Staff, LTG Eyal Zamir, arrived at the scene of the shooting attack in the Neve Tzuf area, under the Binyamin Regional Brigade. There, he conducted a situational assessment, toured the scene, and held an initial inquiry together with the Commander of the Central Command, MG Avi Bluth; the Commander of the Judea and Samaria Division, BG Kobi Heller; the Commander of the Israel Police’s Judea and Samaria District; representatives of the ISA; and additional commanders. During the situational assessment, the Chief of the General Staff instructed forces to initiate a closure, continue the pursuit of those who assisted the terrorist, and seal and dismantle his residence.
The Chief of the General Staff, LTG Eyal Zamir, said: “This was a severe terrorist attack, and I send our condolences to the family of the victim. We acted quickly-the despicable terrorist was apprehended by IDF troops. Our mission is not over. We will impose a closure on the village and conduct investigations, through which we will reach everyone who assisted the terrorist."
"Ahead of Yom Kippur, we reinforced our soldiers on the frontlines and placed additional forces on standby for immediate deployment. On this holy day, as the people of Israel gather for Yom Kippur prayers, the IDF continues to stand guard. The IDF is on high alert, deployed and prepared with reinforced soldiers across all sectors, including throughout the fast. Our mission is clear and ongoing-to thwart terrorism, act decisively against every threat, and protect the citizens of the State of Israel."

item.title: Netanel Shakron, father of six, identified as victim of shooting attack near Neveh Tzuf
item.description: The Samaria Regional Council announced the murder of Netanel Shakron, a resident of Alei Zahav, in the shooting attack at the Ein Raya spring near Neve Tzuf in Binyamin. Shakron, a father of six, arrived at the spring on Sunday morning with his eldest son to immerse ahead of Yom Kippur. He is survived by his wife, Meirav, and their six children. The eldest is in 11th grade, while the youngest is four years old. Shakron worked as an information systems analyst at Hachshara Insurance Company. His wife, Dr. Meirav Shakron, is a lecturer at Ariel University.

item.title: IDF eliminates terrorists who participated in October 7th, advanced attacks against IDF troops
item.description:
Yesterday (Saturday), the IDF and ISA struck and eliminated Yahya Hamdouna, a terrorist in Hamas’ military wing, who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th Massacre.
In additional strikes over the weekend, the IDF and ISA eliminated two additional Hamas terrorists: Muhammad Rafaei, a terrorist from the Daraj Tuffah Battalion who infiltrated Israeli territory during the October 7th massacre, and Basir Al-Barsh, a Nukhba Commander.
Recently, the terrorists advanced attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat.

item.title: Ben-Gvir calls for Neveh Tzuf area terrorist to be put to death
item.description:
Otzma Yehudit chairman and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir called for applying the terrorist death penalty law, which he said his party had advanced, to the terrorist who carried out the attack in Binyamin.
“This is the first case in which the terrorist death penalty law can be implemented," he said.
Ben-Gvir argued that the death penalty is mandatory in this case and must be imposed: “The law is the law. This is the law we passed, the law that allows the terrorist to be executed, and this is the opportunity. Execute him now."

item.title: Yisrael Ganz calls on government to launch broad counterterror operation
item.description:
After the forces apprehended the terrorist who murdered an Israeli near Neveh Tzuf, Binyamin Region Governor and Yesha Council Chief Yisrael Ganz stated: “I commend the security forces for their swift action, which removed the threat to the residents of Binyamin. I am deeply sorry that the despicable murderer remains alive. On the eve of Yom Kippur, he sought to take lives and break our spirit, but he failed. The people of Israel will not be intimidated or broken by terrorism.
"The capture of the terrorist is not the end of the incident. Judea and Samaria are flooded with illegal weapons, and the Palestinian Authority’s security forces possess tens of thousands of weapons that could be turned against us. Nearly three years after October 7, we must not wait for another disaster. I call on the Government of Israel to immediately launch a broad operation to collect illegal weapons, dismantle terrorist infrastructure, and disarm the Palestinian Authority and its security forces."

item.title: Tragedy in Slovenia: Gil Hallel, 44, from Kibbutz Yizra‘el, drowns while on vacation
item.description: Gil Hallel, 44, a father of three from Kibbutz Yizra‘el, drowned to death during a family vacation in Slovenia. The circumstances of the incident are being investigated.

item.title: Terrorist who committed murder in Binyamin today apprehended
item.description:
Following a joint pursuit by security forces and ISA guidance, IDF soldiers apprehended the terrorist who carried out the shooting attack in the Neveh Tzuf area.
Minutes after the shooting, a soldier who was operating near the scene arrived at the location and fired at the terrorist. As a result, the terrorist was injured and fled the scene.
IDF soldiers apprehended the terrorist after he fled to a hospital near the site of the attack.

item.title: Herzog: 'On the eve of Yom Kippur, let us say clearly, terror will not break us'
item.description: President Isaac Herzog said in response to the deadly shooting attack in Binyamin: “The deadly terror attack in Binyamin comes just before Yom Kippur, when the people of Israel gather for the holiest day of the year. I bow my head in memory of the victim murdered in the terror attack. I share wholeheartedly in the grief of his family and community and pray for the recovery of the wounded. On the eve of this sacred festival, let it be stated clearly: Terror will not break us, and it will not shake our spirit. We will stand against terror together, united, resolute, and full of faith."

item.description: A man in his 30s has been declared dead after being critically injured in a suspected terrorist shooting attack near Neveh Tzuf.

item.title: Yisrael Ganz at scene of shooting: 'We are strong, will get through this
item.description:
Binyamin Regional Council Head and Chairman of the Yesha Council, Yisrael Ganz, said at the scene of the attack in Neve Tzuf: “Residents came to the spring ahead of Yom Kippur to immerse themselves in the water. A terrorist arrived armed with an M16 and opened fire on them. One of the residents was very seriously wounded and is being evacuated to the hospital."
"IDF forces, the police, Shin Bet, and Border Police are all pursuing the terrorist, who is still in the area.
"This is a very difficult incident, but we are strong, and we will get through this as well. With God’s help, during Sukkot this place will once again be filled with visitors. No one will drive us away from here."

item.title: Arabs threw stones at Jews in Silwan
item.description:
Police have opened an investigation after Arabs threw stones at a group of young Jews in the Silwan neighborhood of eastern Jerusalem. According to initial investigation, one of the young men, sensing danger, fired into the air to drive the suspects away.
No injuries were reported. The police and Border Police are conducting searches to locate the suspects.

item.title: Terrorist who tried to run over soldiers in Samaria eliminated
item.description: Initial report of an attempted ramming of two soldiers at the Ganim checkpoint in northern Samaria. The forces returned fire and killed one terrorist, and another terrorist was captured. No casualties were reported among the forces.

item.title: MDA responds to Neveh Tzuf shooting
item.description:
Magen David Adom personnel provided updates on the terrorist shooting attack in Binyamin.
MDA Paramedic David Trachtenberg said: “We arrived at the scene and saw a male in his 30s inside a vehicle, unconscious, with multiple gunshot wounds. We removed him from the vehicle and immediately began providing life-saving medical treatment. We placed him in the ambulance, and with the assistance of a physician and a paramedic, immediately began evacuating him to the hospital while fighting for his life, providing medical treatment and blood products, in the hope of stabilizing his condition."
MDA EMT Yosef Rimal said: “We received a report of a man who had been injured by gunfire. We arrived at the scene with a large number of forces and found the man unconscious. We immediately began providing advanced medical treatment, including controlling bleeding, bandaging and administering medications, and evacuated him in an MDA ambulance in serious condition."
